scope: Sanitized evaluator review copies; no native raw streams, reasoning, command bodies, configs or omitted source payloads are exported. Product approval and campaign acceptance remain separate.

identity_policy.artifact:campaign/: Stable path relative to the experiment campaign root; nonclickable, not evidence that payload is included.
identity_policy.artifact:landing/: Stable landing-relative identity; not itself a link or inclusion assertion.
identity_policy.artifact:external/: Opaque SHA-256-derived identity plus basename for an external host path.
identity_policy.retained-value:: SHA-256 identity for omitted native command text; UTF-8 hash and character count retained.
identity_policy.source_relative_paths: Unprefixed relative paths remain scoped to the original review record and its identified source or repository; no bundled payload inclusion is implied.
identity_policy.original_line_locators: Line numbers remain original source coordinates. Markdown banner adds two export lines.
identity_policy.original_hashes: Reviewer hashes are preserved unchanged and describe original payloads; export hashes below describe transformed files.
identity_policy.historical_paths: Historical draft paths remain identities; no substitution with a current final artifact.

selected_source_coverage.missing_json_disposition: No JSON source exists; no sibling manufactured.
No JSON source exists; no sibling manufactured.
